**Texere 0.5.3** · 16 November 2026

- **Locked PDFs can be highlighted.** A PDF locked by its publisher (encrypted with no password) is unlocked when you open it, so PDF++ can write your highlights into it. Its bookmarks and details stay intact.
- **Clear messages** when a highlight can't be written: a PDF with a password, a read-only file, a damaged PDF, each with what to do.

Update: the **Update** button on Texere's home page.
